title: Stop is the ask event; a 15-minute quiet gate keeps the ask at a pause
context: Claude Code SessionEnd output is discarded, cannot speak to the user, and shares a 1.5 second budget across hooks; Stop is the only lifecycle event that can put words in front of the user. A Stop after every rcf feedback add would interrupt the operator mid-task and read as nagging. Wrap-up cues (operator says "done", queue complete) miss most single-session users.
decision:
The ask is triggered from the Stop hook (Claude Code exit 2 + stderr; Codex JSON { decision: "block", reason }). The quiet rule (design section 3.5) requires all of: not opted out, pending entries exist, no prior asked record for this session_id, stop_hook_active is false, AND one of: entry carries askNow; the newest pending entry is older than quietMinutes (default 15) minutes; the queue-state cache reports complete or nothing actionable; the entry was carried over. quietMinutes is configurable in rcf/feedback-settings.json; --ask-now on rcf feedback add bypasses the age gate for a blocker-severity entry.

Operator default (pending, adjustable): Fifteen-minute quiet gate with quietMinutes configurable and --ask-now for blocker-severity entries accepted as the operator default pending, adjustable. Baz can widen or shorten quietMinutes in rcf/feedback-settings.json at any time without a code change.
consequences: The ask arrives at a natural pause with the exact preview text, exactly once per session_id, with a durable asked ledger that survives a crash between emit and reply. A single-session user is asked; a wrap-up-only design would miss most. quietMinutes is the single knob for anyone who finds 15 too eager or too shy.

alternativesConsidered.name: Ask at the first Stop after any add
alternativesConsidered.summary: Drop the age and queue gate; the first Stop after any add asks.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Interrupts the operator mid-task and reads as nagging even though it is one question.

alternativesConsidered.name: Ask on strict wrap-up cues only
alternativesConsidered.summary: Only ask when the operator says "done" or the queue reports complete.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Many single-session users are never asked.

alternativesConsidered.name: Ask on SessionEnd only
alternativesConsidered.summary: Move the ask to SessionEnd so it never fires mid-session.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: SessionEnd cannot speak to the user in either harness; loses single-session users entirely.
